summary: Per-Store returns/refunds policy (Open / Needs approval / Off) and Owner/Admin approval requests. orders.refund and orders.returnItems now enforce the Store setting (Off locks everyone; Needs approval makes everyone below Owner/Admin ask; a Return paying money back also follows Refunds). Staff ask with the exact command, an Owner/Admin approves or rejects, and the requester records exactly that via orders.recordApprovedChange before the end of the business day. No assistant capability is added: any future assistant return/refund draft (D03) must apply the same Store rules, and approving staff requests stays a human Owner/Admin decision.

procedures.reason: Read of the Store rule the D03 return/refund drafts must apply.
Owner/Admin read of waiting requests; a D03 read candidate.
Staff ask for a return/refund; joins the D03 return/refund packet.
Requester withdraws their own request; joins D03.
Records an approved return/refund; joins D03 with orders.refund/returnItems.
Owner/Admin Store setting; candidate section for settings.store.change (G05).
Approving a staff return or refund is the Owner/Admin's own decision, never drafted by the assistant.
Unchanged D03 plan; now refuses when the Store's Refunds setting is Off or the caller must ask first.
Unchanged D03 plan; now refuses when Returns is Off, the caller must ask, or cash back is not allowed.

docs.note: Owner/Admin approve and edit the setting; scoped staff may ask, withdraw and record.
